titles.title: แผนเขมือบงูของกระต่ายยั่ว
ลิ้มรสรัก นายอสรพิษ

description:
“I’ll fuck you plenty from now on.”

Myo Yeonho, a rabbit beastman, has been desperately searching for someone with his ideal “equipment.” After spectacularly failing to buy an extra-large, thick and mighty goblin club, and while sulking because his friends kept teasing him for being a premature ejaculator, Yeonho hears about a new student named Sa Jeonghyeok, a snake beastman. The freshman is incredibly handsome, and according to the rumors, because he’s a snake beastman, he has two “things” down there—and plenty of stamina to match…. Will this shameless rabbit succeed in his plan to devour the snake?
